newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PSC gets Australian healthcare contract.
newsitem.headline: PSC gets Australian healthcare contract.

text.p: Provisions Suppliers Corp Ltd (PSC) said on Friday it signed a healthcare management and consultancy contract with the western Australian government.
The contract, granted to its 51 percent subsidiary Health Solutions (Western Australia) Pty Ltd, would be to manage an existing 32-bed public hospital in Perth.
Expansion and refurbishment works were in store for the hospital and when completed in June 1998, PSC would manage the hospital for 20 years, it said.
PSC said it had invested Australian $2 million in the project and did not expect any impact on current year earnings.
